text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While walking through the academy—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so very much, everyone♪ This has 
been Fine Motion~!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Phew!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ho, quite an elegant performance. Are you 
practicing for a Winning Live?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Groove-san! Just in time!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I'm trying to figure out 
through trial and error what kind of 
routine would get the crowd most excited!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'll perform it from the start one more 
time, so could you watch and tell me what 
you think?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You seem to be taking it seriously this 
time... Very well. Show me.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Thank you! And now... *deep breath*...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
HEEEEY!! Step right up, come on in, gather 
'round!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Come one, come all, feast your eyes! Fine 
Motion's live show is about to begin!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Our half-fried-rice combo is a super deal! 
Enjoy extra noodle refills on the house, 
folks!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
—And that's all from Fine Motion! How was 
that?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Let me get this straight. What was that 
barker-style spiel at the start supposed 
to be?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you noticed? As expected of you! After 
all, a live show is all about the 'hook', 
right?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
So, I used market street hawkers and ramen 
shop callouts as reference!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
With this, everyone is sure to stop in 
their tracks! Because that's exactly what 
happened to me♪

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Just to be completely clear, you aren't 
doing this as a joke, are you?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Of course not! The theme is 'Bring a spark 
of excitement to everyone watching♪', 
after all!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Why would that theme lead to such a 
performance? Merely being eccentric is not 
the answer.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah, please keep the feedback coming! I'm 
not quite used to 'putting on a show' 
yet~.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I was taught how to carry myself while 
'being looked at' as etiquette, but this 
is completely different, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want to take everyone's 
feedback and improve bit by bit♪

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I see you are making an effort in your 
own way. Then do it once more. I will 
evaluate you strictly.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yay, thank you! In that case, may I 
consult you on something right away?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Would 'Large portion size at no extra 
charge' make people happier than 'Free 
noodle refills'?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Get away from ramen for a moment! First, 
grasp what your audience actually expects 
of you—
